definitions.gloss: crew member; staff member on a vehicle
definitions.explanation: A person who works on board a train, airplane, bus, or ship as part of their job. Includes drivers, conductors, flight attendants, and other onboard personnel.

examples.japanese: {乗務員|じょうむいん}に{声|こえ}をかけた。
examples.english: I called out to a crew member.

examples.japanese: {乗務員|じょうむいん}が{安全|あんぜん}{確認|かくにん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The crew member carried out a safety check.

examples.japanese: {体調|たいちょう}が{悪|わる}くなったら、{近|ちか}くの{乗務員|じょうむいん}にお{知|し}らせください。
examples.english: If you start feeling unwell, please let a nearby crew member know.

notes:
A general term for any staff member who works onboard a vehicle as part of their duty. Commonly heard in announcements on trains and airplanes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {客室|きゃくしつ}{乗務員|じょうむいん}: cabin crew, flight attendant
- {乗務員|じょうむいん}{室|しつ}: crew room, crew quarters
- {乗務員|じょうむいん}{交代|こうたい}: crew change
- {乗務員|じょうむいん}{不足|ふそく}: crew shortage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {車掌|しゃしょう}: train conductor — specific role on a train
- {運転士|うんてんし}: train driver — specific role
- キャビンアテンダント (CA): cabin attendant — specific to airplanes
- クルー: crew — loanword, more casual

FORMS:
{乗務|じょうむ} (duty aboard a vehicle) + {員|いん} (member, personnel).
